What's new in 0.30.0

• A new opening: when Zylo starts, the house lights go down, a projector beam reaches across and the Z lights up, with its own sound. It plays while the app loads, so it never adds waiting, and any button skips it.
• Turn the sound off in Settings > Playback > Opening sound. With Reduce motion on, there's no opening at all.
